operational_failure.severity: audit-blocking provenance defect; NOT a measurement defect
operational_failure.detail: REPORT.md sections 0 and 1 and state/frontier/frontier-counter-evidence-span-selection.json run_history[0].note both cite commit 'dad93c36' as the pre-measurement protocol freeze commit. That object does not exist in the repository: `git cat-file -t dad93c36` returns 'fatal: Not a valid object name dad93c36'. The producer branch was published as a single squashed commit e9ee955e8f5e2679572257731130c70febcb4c68, which orphans the intermediate local commit hash the report cites. An independent auditor verifying acceptance criterion (1) - FREEZE FIRST, commit a machine-readable protocol record before any measurement - by resolving the cited commit would fail to locate the freeze and could return AUDIT_BLOCKED on a broken provenance chain even though the freeze itself is intact.
operational_failure.root_cause: The report was drafted against the producer's local pre-squash history; the branch was then published squashed, so the commit-addressed citation became unresolvable. The freeze witness was recorded in two places, one commit-addressed (broken) and one content-addressed (intact).
